notes: Route: permissive robots.txt (200; disallows only /wp-admin/*, /poze/*, /*?s=; names a /sitemap_index.xml that 404s, so ignored). Probes: /sitemap_index.xml 404, /news-sitemap.xml 404, /feed/ 200 (RSS, 82KB), /wp-sitemap.xml 200 = stock WordPress index with 374 post-sitemap pages in ASCENDING id order (page 1 = 2011-10-14; pages 372-374 cover 2026-09-01..2026-10-26, ~6000 urls, <lastmod> ascending). Chose WP REST instead: GET /wp-json/wp/v2/posts?per_page=100&_fields=date,link&after=2026-09-25T00:00:00&before=2026-10-25T23:59:59&page=N, HTTP 200 throughout, 31 pages, stopped on 400/short page. Listed date = date-part of the REST local 'date' (site-local EET/EEST). Verification: 4 sample articles re-fetched (1x 09-30, 1x 10-10, 2x 10-20) all HTTP 200 with 5300-7600 chars of visible text and JSON-LD datePublished date equal to the listed date on every sample. Output: 3055 unique URLs, 31/31 days, 09-30=133, 10-10=90, 10-20=134, min 40 (10-04). ~31 requests, ~16 s.
